paper_overview.sets_note: MPBSE typically 4 sets: A, B, C, D. Har set mein same questions hote hain, sirf order alag hota hai.
paper_overview.language_of_attempt: English only. Hindi mein likhne se marks nahi milenge.
paper_overview.all_compulsory_note: 15 questions total — mostly all compulsory. Kuch questions mein internal OR choice hoti hai (Q3/Q4/Q5, Q14, Q15).
paper_overview.ncert_enough: NCERT (Flamingo + Vistas) compulsory hai. Section D ke sare questions NCERT chapters se hi aate hain. Sample papers aur previous year papers bhi zaroori hain.

sample_paper_vs_model_paper.sample_paper: Officially MPBSE ya NCERT ki taraf se jari hota hai. Actual exam pattern aur difficulty level dikhata hai.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.model_paper: Teachers ya coaching institutes banate hain practice ke liye.
sample_paper_vs_model_paper.question_bank: Previous year questions ka collection. Revision ke liye best.

question_types_in_exam.summary: English MPBSE Class 12 paper mein 4 sections hain: A (Reading), B (Writing), C (Grammar), D (Textbooks). Total 15 questions, 80 marks.

types.how_to_attempt: Passage pehle ek baar quickly padho. Phir questions padho. MCQ mein options se answer dhundho. Vocabulary questions mein noun/adjective forms puchhte hain — grammar yaad rakho.
types.notes: Main idea, author's tone aur vocabulary questions har saal aate hain. Passage se seedha answer milta hai — imagination mat lagao.

types.how_to_attempt: Notes points mein likhni hain — complete sentences nahi. Abbreviations use karo. Main heading + sub-headings format use karo. Title concise aur relevant hona chahiye.
types.word_limit: Notes mein full sentences nahi — bullet points ya short phrases
types.notes: Note making mein format marks milte hain. Roman numerals (I, II, III) aur indentation use karo. Abbreviations clearly define karo agar use karo.

types.how_to_attempt: Format marks milte hain — proper heading/date/signature hamesha likho. Content relevant aur concise rakho.
types.notes: Notice mein NOTICE heading capital mein, school/organisation ka naam, date, aur issuing authority zaroori hain.

types.how_to_attempt: Format strictly follow karo — address, date, subject, salutation, body paragraphs, closing. Content relevant aur well-organized rakho.
types.notes: Formal letter mein 'Yours faithfully' aur informal mein 'Yours affectionately/sincerely' use karo. Yeh marks dilata hai.

types.how_to_attempt: Report mein headline aur dateline zaroori hain. Paragraph mein topic sentence pehle likhni chahiye. Word limit strictly follow karo.
Options mein se grammatically correct option choose karo. Grammar rules apply karo — lest ke saath 'should', made of/from, articles ka use.
types.notes: Lest = should. 'Made of' for material. 'Made from' for chemical change. 'The' for specific nouns. Ye rules yaad karo.

types.how_to_attempt: Instruction carefully padho. Ek bhi word unnecessarily mat badlo. Sirf required transformation karo.
types.notes: 'As soon as' ko 'No sooner...than' mein badalne ka pattern: 'No sooner did + subject + verb + than + subject + verb.' Har saal aata hai.

types.how_to_attempt: Extract dhyan se padho. Questions mostly character identification, event identification, word meaning, mood/tone ke hote hain. Options mein se sahi jawab choose karo.
types.notes: Har chapter ka central character, key event aur important quotes yaad karo. Extract se hi answer milta hai — wild guess mat karo.

types.how_to_attempt: Poetry extract mein poet ka naam, poem ka theme, poetic devices (metaphor, imagery) aur specific line meanings puchhte hain. Vistas extract mein character identification aur event-based questions hote hain.
2 marks = 2 clear points. 30 words = 2-3 sentences. Direct, factual answer likhna hai — lengthy explanation nahi chahiye.
types.notes: Pehle saare 7 questions padho. Jinke jawab clearly pata hain unhe select karo. Do not attempt all 7 even if you think you know — only 5 required.

types.how_to_attempt: Poetry questions mein imagery, symbolism aur central idea puchha jaata hai. 2-3 lines mein concise answer do. Quote line from poem agar relevant ho.
types.notes: Answer any 3 out of 4 questions — 2 marks each, about 30 words

types.how_to_attempt: Vistas ke chapters se direct factual questions hote hain. Short, precise answer do.
types.notes: Answer any 2 out of 3 questions — 2 marks each, about 30 words

types.how_to_attempt: 3 marks = introduction + 2-3 key points + brief conclusion. 75 words mein complete, well-structured answer likhna hai. Title justification, character analysis, theme explanation — these are common question types.
types.notes: Har answer mein chapter ka naam ya character ka naam pehli line mein mention karo. Structured paragraphs mein likho.

types.how_to_attempt: Central idea, theme, poetic devices — these are common. 75 words mein poem ka message clearly explain karo. Poem ki kuch specific lines cite karo.
types.notes: Dono OR options padho. Jis poem ke baare mein zyaada pata ho woh select karo.

types.how_to_attempt: Character sketch, theme explanation, plot summary — these are common. 75 words mein well-organized answer likhna hai.
types.notes: Character sketch mein physical appearance se zyaada character traits aur actions par focus karo.

paper_pattern.note: English paper has 4 sections A to D. Total 15 questions. Maximum 80 marks. Duration 3 hours.
paper_pattern.internal_choice_note: Internal choice in Q3/Q4/Q5, Q14, Q15. Also "any N of M" pattern in Q6, Q7, Q10, Q11, Q12, Q13.

sections.name: Section A — Reading Skills
sections.breakdown: Q1 = 10 marks unseen passage MCQs. Q2 = 4 marks note making.
sections.notes: Section A mein koi choice nahi — dono questions compulsory hain.

sections.name: Section B — Writing Skills
sections.breakdown: Q3 = 4 marks (Notice/Ad/Poster with OR). Q4 = 4 marks (Letter with OR). Q5 = 4 marks (Report/Paragraph with OR).
sections.notes: Har question mein OR option hota hai. Dono mein se ek attempt karo.

sections.name: Section C — Grammar
sections.breakdown: Q6 = Fill blanks any 5 of 6 (5 marks). Q7 = Do as directed any 5 of 6 (5 marks).
sections.notes: 6 mein se 5 attempt karna hai. Sabse aasaan 5 choose karo.

sections.name: Section D — Textbooks (Flamingo + Vistas)
sections.notes: Section D sabse zyaada marks ka section hai — 44 marks. NCERT chapters thoroughly padhna zaroori hai. Q10 mein any 5 of 7, Q11 mein any 3 of 4, Q12 mein any 2 of 3, Q13 mein any 2 of 3, Q14 mein OR, Q15 mein OR.

marks_distribution.marks_summary_note: Section A=14, B=12, C=10, D=44 = 80 theory + 20 IA = 100

grammar_syllabus.note: Section C grammar topics — fill in blanks (Q6) and do as directed (Q7).

frequently_asked: made of = for material (table made of wood)
made from = for chemical change (wine made from grapes)
Would you like = always followed by 'some' (not any)
Walk carefully OR else = 'else' after imperatives
types: Articles — a, an, the (use with specific/non-specific nouns, vowel sounds)
Prepositions — in, on, at, of, from, with, into, by, for
Tenses — Present perfect (have/has + V3), Past simple, Future
Modals — can/could, may/might, should, would, will, lest+should
Conjunctions — lest, unless, else, although, as long as, as soon as
Determiners — any, some, many, much, few, little, a lot of

frequently_asked: As soon as → No sooner + did/had + subject + V1/V3 + than + subject + V2
Too tired to work → So tired that he could not work
Mumbai is larger than Bhopal → Bhopal is not as large as Mumbai (positive degree)
He failed. He did not study. → He failed, so he did not study / He failed because he did not study
types: Direct to Indirect narration (all types — statement, question, command)
Degrees of comparison — Positive to Comparative to Superlative
Combining sentences — using who/which/that, so/because, although/though
Identifying clause types — noun clause, adjective clause, adverb clause

writing_section_formats.note: Section B writing formats — notice, advertisement, letters, report, paragraph.

formats.structure: NOTICE (heading — centered, capital) | Name of organisation/school | Date | Subject/Title of notice (underlined) | Body — what, who, when, where (2-3 sentences) | Name and Designation of issuing authority
formats.tip: Box format mein likhna highly recommended. NOTICE heading hamesha capital mein.

formats.structure: Catchy headline (bold/capital) | Product/Service details | Key features (3-4 bullet points) | Price if applicable | Contact details — phone/address | Box format
formats.tip: Classified ad chhota aur to-the-point hona chahiye. Contact details compulsory hain.

formats.structure: Sender's address (right side) | Date | Receiver's address/designation (left side) | Subject (underlined) | Salutation — Sir/Madam | Body — 3 paragraphs (reason/problem/request) | Complimentary close — Yours faithfully | Signature + Full name
formats.tip: Subject line hamesha likhna zaroori hai. 'Yours faithfully' for formal, 'Yours sincerely' for semi-formal.

formats.structure: Sender's address | Date | Salutation — Dear [Name] | Body — personal tone, 2-3 paragraphs | Complimentary close — Yours affectionately/Yours lovingly | Signature
formats.tip: Informal letter mein casual, friendly tone. No subject line needed.

formats.structure: Headline (bold, striking) | Dateline — Place, Date (e.g., Bhopal, April 14) | Byline — By [Reporter Name] (optional) | Lead paragraph — 5W+1H (what/where/when/who/why/how) | Body — details, quotes, aftermath | Concluding line
formats.tip: Report mein third person likhna zaroori hai — 'I was there' nahi likhna. Passive voice aur past tense use karo.

formats.structure: Introduction — topic sentence (1-2 lines) | Body — 3-4 supporting points | Conclusion — summarising statement
formats.tip: Word limit strictly 120 words. Introduction aur conclusion hamesha likhna zaroori hai.

practical_paper.practical_exam_note: English has no practical exam. Internal assessment (20 marks) covers projects/assignments.

tips: Section D mein 44 marks hain — yahaan sabse zyaada time do
Q10 mein 7 mein se 5 — pehle saare 7 padho, jinke jawab pakke pata hain unhe select karo
Extract questions (Q8, Q9) mein extract se hi answer milta hai — chapter yaad na ho tab bhi attempt karo
Grammar Q6 aur Q7 mein 6 mein se 5 — sabse mushkil wala skip karo
Writing Section (B) mein format marks alag hote hain — format galat mat karo
Note Making (Q2) mein complete sentences mat likhna — bullet points only
Letter mein address, date, subject, salutation, closing — sab likhna zaroori hai
Long answers (Q13, Q14, Q15) mein word limit 75 words — count karke rakho
Unseen passage (Q1) carefully padhne se 10 marks almost pakke hain
NCERT ke chapter summaries aur character sketches yaad karo
Previous year papers solve karo — same question types repeat hote hain
Set number cover page pe likhna mat bhoolna

time_allocation.note: 30 min — Q1 passage carefully padhke 10 MCQ. Q2 note making format carefully.
35 min — Formats prepare karke rakho. Content 5-7 min per question.
20 min — Grammar rules apply karo. Any 5 of 6 — skip the toughest one.
75 min — Extract questions pehle (Q8, Q9). Phir Q10-Q13 short/long answers.
5-10 min — spellings check karo, word limits verify karo

targets.strategy: Section A Q1 MCQs (8-10 marks almost certain if passage read carefully). Grammar Q6 fill blanks (4-5 marks). Section D Q10 easy prose questions (4-6 marks). Total = 16-21 marks easily.
focus_areas: Q1 — Unseen passage MCQs (no chapter prep needed — just read carefully)
Q6 — Articles, prepositions, modals (basic grammar rules)
Q10 — The Last Lesson, Deep Water, Indigo (3 easy chapters)
Q9A — Keeping Quiet, My Mother at Sixty-Six (2 easy poems)
chapters_to_skip_safely: Journey to the End of the Earth (complex)

targets.strategy: Section A full (12-14 marks) + Grammar (8-10 marks) + Section D Q8/Q9/Q10 (15-18 marks) = 35-42 marks.
focus_areas: Q1 + Q2 full Section A (practice note making format)
Q8 — Last Lesson extract (memorise key quotes)
Q10 — any 5 from prose chapters you know well
Q11 — Keeping Quiet + My Mother at Sixty-Six

targets.strategy: Section A (14) + Section B (8-10) + Grammar (10) + Section D Q8-Q13 (30-35) = 62-69 marks.
focus_areas: Section B — practice letter formats and report writing
All Flamingo prose chapters — short answers Q10 + Q13
Vistas — at least 3 chapters for Q12 + Q15

targets.strategy: All 15 questions attempt with full preparation. Section B scoring mein creativity aur vocabulary help karta hai.
focus_areas: Vocabulary — use varied words in writing sections
Long answers — practice writing in 75 words exactly
